name: Bronze Age
description: Bronze begins when the mature Copper workshop can turn Cassiterite into Tin and alloy it with Copper.

pages.text: $(bold)Entering the Bronze Age$()$(br2)Bronze is no longer an arbitrary crafting unlock. The transition starts with Cassiterite and requires the full Copper Age processing chain: grinding, water washing, crank-driven sifting and furnace smelting.

$(bold)Tin production$()$(br2)Cassiterite Ore -> Crushed Cassiterite -> Washed Cassiterite -> Tin Concentrate -> Tin Ingot.$(br2)The Washer requires clean water and produces Dirty Water. The Gear V2-driven Sifter is required to refine Washed Cassiterite into Tin Concentrate. It can also optionally sift any Gravel into Sand and Flint.$(br2)If you cannot make Tin yet, complete the Grinder, Washer and Sifter chapters of the Copper Workshop.

$(bold)Bronze alloy$()$(br2)Prepare one Bronze Alloy Charge from three Copper Ingots and one Tin Ingot, then fire it with coal in the Primitive Furnace. One charge produces four Bronze Ingots and Slag.$(br2)Bronze machinery and tools will build from this point.
